copy.tagline: 自动执行ActiveCampaign中的营销任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常手动操作ActiveCampaign任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently handle ActiveCampaign tasks manually

howto.what: Claude 通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 ActiveCampaign 操作。它会先搜索当前可用的工具模式，然后检查连接状态，最后执行指定的 ActiveCampaign 任务。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 ActiveCampaign 中的联系人或营销活动时，例如创建、更新联系人或发送邮件。

say.text: 帮我添加一个新联系人，邮箱 user@example.com
列出所有未开启的营销活动
say.note: Claude 将搜索并执行相关工具获取列表。

say.text: 给联系人列表发送一封欢迎邮件
say.note: Claude 将执行邮件发送操作。

howto.what_en: Claude automates ActiveCampaign tasks via Rube MCP. It searches for current tool schemas, checks connection, then executes ActiveCampaign operations like creating contacts or sending emails.
howto.when_en: When you ask to manage ActiveCampaign contacts or campaigns, e.g., create/update contacts or send emails.

say_en.text: Add a new contact with email user@example.com
say_en.note: Claude will call ActiveCampaign to create contact.
Claude will search and execute tools to get the list.

say_en.text: Send a welcome email to my contact list
say_en.note: Claude will execute the email sending operation.
